description: This Java abstract class defines a template for processing loan items within the context of a batch job, including handling business steps, setting business date, and integrating with COB business step service.

classes.name: AbstractLoanItemProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class implementing ItemProcessor for Loan objects with processing logic related to business steps and business date handling.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a Loan item by retrieving business steps, executing COB business step service, and setting the last closed business date.

methods.name: afterStep
methods.description: Defines the action after a batch step completes, returning an ExitStatus.

methods.name: setBusinessDate
methods.description: Sets the business date from the job execution context.
